author: botagas
install_msg: RoomAnnounce is a companion for Roomer. Load Roomer first and enable the Guild Presences intent for automatic game detection.
name: RoomAnnounce
short: Advertise Roomer voice channels with game metadata.
description: Creates persistent announcement controls, local previews, and public game-room advertisements for Roomer channels.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily stores Roomer channel IDs, owner IDs, game announcement settings, and owner-provided announcement text until the room is deleted.
